title: Balanced Brackets
statement:
Given a string `s` made only of the characters `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{` and `}`, decide whether it is **balanced**:

- every opening bracket is closed by a bracket of the same type, and
- brackets close in the correct order.

The empty string is balanced.
hints: Push opening brackets; a closing bracket must match the top of the stack.
